mod.name: TB Basic Needs
mod.summary: A hygiene and bodily needs survival layer. Players have to go to the toilet, get dirty, and wash themselves and their clothes at wells, sinks, washing machines and static washing places; staying dirty can make them ill. A HUD shows the needs. Dryers and washing machines use energy, water and detergent.
mod.notes: Several sample defaults differ from the doc defaults (for example tickLengthInMinutes and dirtIncrementRegular), because the sample is a test server file; the schema keeps the sample values as defaults. The mod misspells "PerMinuted" in some field names; the spelling must stay exactly as written. The docs mention admins can reload the static washing places config without a restart, other changes are safest with a restart.

files.title: Body zone dirt rates
files.summary: One file per body or clothing zone (Base is the body itself). Sets how much dirt that zone collects from each need.

name.label: Zone name
name.help: Name of the zone. It must match an entry in BodyZones.json zoneNames.

dirtIncrementWhenPoo.label: Dirt when pooing
dirtIncrementWhenPoo.help: Dirt this zone gains when the player relieves themselves outside a toilet (poo).

dirtIncrementWhenPee.label: Dirt when peeing
dirtIncrementWhenPee.help: Dirt this zone gains when the player pees outside a toilet.

dirtIncrementRegular.label: Regular dirt gain
dirtIncrementRegular.help: Dirt this zone gains over time while the player is already dirty. The doc default is much higher than the value in the sample file, so compare before changing.

dirtIncrementWhenPooToilet.label: Dirt when pooing in a toilet
dirtIncrementWhenPooToilet.help: Dirt gained when a toilet is used for poo. Much lower than outside, which rewards using toilets.

dirtIncrementWhenPeeToilet.label: Dirt when peeing in a toilet
dirtIncrementWhenPeeToilet.help: Dirt gained when a toilet is used for pee.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Version number the mod writes into this file so it can upgrade older files. Leave it exactly as it is.
version.risk: Changing it can make the mod reset or reject the file.
